landing.title: Tolon: a gentle reminder that takes over your screen before meetings
landing.description: Tolon is an open-source desktop app that takes over your screen a minute before each meeting, so you join on time.
landing.h1: A minute before your meeting, Tolon makes sure you notice.
landing.p1: Tolon is an open-source desktop app that takes over your screen a minute before each meeting, so you join on time. It reads your calendars on your own computer. There is no account and no telemetry.
landing.p2: We are choosing its icon. Six ideas are below, and we would like to know which one you would want on your Dock or taskbar.

pool.title: Tolon icon poll
pool.p1: Tolon is an open-source desktop app that takes over your screen a minute before each meeting, so you join on time. It works only on your computer, needs no account and sends no telemetry.
pool.p2: We have six candidate icons. Pick the one you would want on your Dock or taskbar. You can also react to each icon and leave a comment. It takes about two minutes, and the order is random for every visitor.

privacy.title: How we handle your data
privacy.who: Daniel Fernandes runs this poll and is responsible for your data.
privacy.what: We store your email, your favorite, your reactions and your comment.
privacy.why: We keep them for one reason: so that each person votes once.
privacy.processors: Two services process data on our behalf:
privacy.processor.cloudflare: Cloudflare (bot check and rate limiting; it sees your IP address)
privacy.processor.resend: Resend (sends the code email, EU region)
privacy.tracking: There are no tracking pixels or tracked links.
privacy.deletion: Your data is deleted when the first Tolon beta is released, and no later than {date}.
privacy.deletionNoDate: Your data is deleted when the first Tolon beta is released.
privacy.ask: To ask for deletion, write to {contact}.
privacy.askNoContact: To ask for deletion, ask Daniel.

pv.title: Tolon preview
pv.h1: See why the icons look like this
pv.p: Tolon has one job: a minute before a meeting it covers your screen so you cannot miss it. The icons below are judged against that moment. The reminder and the calendars page on this page are the real Tolon interface, running in your browser with sample data. Nothing you do here is saved or sent.
pv.why1.title: It has to be friendly.
pv.why1.text: Tolon covers the whole screen, so the icon sets the tone first: a warm object or a small character, not an alarm.
pv.why2.title: It has to hold up at 16 px.
pv.why2.text: The menu bar shows the icon at 16 px. Every concept was drawn again by hand for that size.
pv.why3.title: It has to belong.
pv.why3.text: The screens use paper, ink and one moss green, so the icons share that palette.
pv.legend: Icon shown on the desktop below
pv.hint: In the reminder, Enter, Esc, D and Space work as they do in the app. Any of them brings you back here.
